notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
Fixes:

-Made some telegraphs show on-screen longer
-Added option to turn on subtitles for Sentinel of Sound fight (appears after losing to it)
-Removed You dialogue thanking Burrow Dweller, as it can occur before speaking for the first time when meeting Sir Cedric
-Fixed bug where Wood Crawlers' telegraphs don't line up with their following attack
-Increased Flame Fingers damage against Wood Crawlers
-Added sound effect to Spar hissing

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Fixes:

-Removed, replaced and reworded some of the more unfair telegraphs
-Added more overt tutorial hints towards the adaptations system
-No longer have to do light puzzle again on the way back
-Ice camp no longer disintegrates after using it once 
-Made shortcut from wooden halls to labyrinth two-way, and added a short scene for it with the knight
-Increased damage against most enemies so fights go quicker
-Changed Gut Gobbler tummy colour to better indicate weakness to poison
-Added underground lake npc
